verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs state that it provides official SDK clients in both Python and TypeScript, so the core of the story is present. The pack never shows these SDKs exposing the Document AI surface (OCR parse, annotation-based extraction, async/batch jobs), and none of the parameter docs are shown as typed SDK calls. Missing for 10: evidence the SDKs cover the OCR/annotation endpoints, evidence of typed request/response models, any jobs/batch support in the SDKs, documented sensible defaults, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.
